clusters.title: Clinical Practice
clusters.description: Topics covering standardized, evidence-informed interventions and workflows delivered to patients, including pharmacological treatment, patient education, and procedural protocols.

clusters.title: Data Quality
clusters.description: Topics addressing deficiencies, inconsistencies, or systemic limitations in how patient-level or process-level data is captured, recorded, or reported within clinical quality registries.

clusters.title: Definitional
clusters.description: Topics focused on precise specifications—clinical, administrative, or methodological—that underpin the consistent interpretation and application of quality indicators, codes, or patient populations.

clusters.title: Exclusion Criteria
clusters.description: Topics describing methodological rules that determine which patients or cases are omitted from the denominator or numerator of clinical quality indicator calculations.

clusters.title: Governance
clusters.description: Topics concerning the organizational oversight bodies, steering committees, or structural anchoring responsible for directing, evaluating, and adapting clinical quality initiatives and registry operations.

clusters.title: Performance
clusters.description: Topics that refer to the measured outcomes of healthcare delivery against defined benchmarks, including aggregate results, variations, trends, and deviations from targets — all framed as evaluations of clinical or operational effectiveness.

clusters.title: Policy Change
clusters.description: Topics documenting formal adjustments to rules, standards, or methodologies governing clinical reporting, indicator calculation, or care delivery frameworks across national quality databases.

clusters.title: Quality Indicator
clusters.description: Topics that define, describe, or operationalize standardized clinical metrics used to assess healthcare quality across national registries. These topics cover the conceptual framework, naming conventions, and functional role of indicators in monitoring care delivery.

clusters.title: Quality Target
clusters.description: Topics referencing predefined performance thresholds or developmental goals (udviklingsmål) set for clinical quality indicators to benchmark and drive improvement in healthcare delivery.

clusters.title: Regional Variation
clusters.description: Topics highlighting disparities in clinical outcomes, performance metrics, or resource distribution across Denmark’s five administrative healthcare regions.
